name: say-back
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud with Kokoro-82M, a fast on-device voice, with a player bar above the prompt. No API keys, nothing leaves your machine.

enabled.title: Speak replies
enabled.description: Turn off to mute without disabling the plugin

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice ID, e.g. af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, bf_emma, bm_george

max_chars.title: Max characters
max_chars.description: Longer replies stop at the last full sentence before this; 0 reads everything
